text:
William Karlsson had a good week by any measure. The Las Vegas Review-Journal's headline: "A dad again, William Karlsson hitting offensive stride for Golden Knights." He and his wife welcomed their third child, and on the ice he scored three goals in two games against Dallas, then won a shootout in Winnipeg with the only goal.

He's playing nearly 18 minutes a night after only 14 games last season, and he has 6 goals and 11 points in 26. Our numbers say he deserves more. Vegas has scored 9.1 fewer goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice, and his own 7.55 expected goals (the quality of his shots) sit above his 6 goals. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking liked where he shoots from: 87th percentile for chances from the home-plate area in front of the net.

He's one of the original Golden Misfits, a Lady Byng winner and a 2023 Stanley Cup champion, and our range has him around 22 goals by April. The Golden Knights have won six of their last ten. A healthy Karlsson playing like this is a big part of why.
headline: Karlsson is back on the score sheet
